items.text: Re-run on the node at block 78962883, the block before, with the transaction's own call, it reverted with the reason 'ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance'. The replay is run on the parent block's state and context (its block number and time), without the transactions that came before it in its own block, and without charging the gas cost (nodes still check that the sender holds the value it sends), so this may differ from what happened in the original transaction.
